quest.title: Search for the Lost Monument Fragments
quest.description: The note Sosi gave you marks the potential locations of the monument fragments. Because mere mortals often fail to discern its shape, you might need Sorush's help retrieving the fragments...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that we've found all the fragments, both of Sosi's commissions are complete! Let's go find her at the monument!
